name: Sleepio (SleepioRx)

lifecycle.notes: SleepioRx is a Big Health product - see big-health entry for comprehensive company info

short_description: FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic for chronic insomnia delivering CBT-I. 76% improvement rate, Medicare coverage as of January 2025, and first DTx to receive NICE guidance.
long_description: SleepioRx (formerly Sleepio) is an FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic from Big Health that delivers Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) via a 90-day digital program. Cleared by the FDA in August 2024 for chronic insomnia in adults 18+, SleepioRx has demonstrated 76% patient improvement rates across 26 clinical trials including 18 RCTs. It became the first digital therapeutic to receive NICE guidance confirming clinical and cost effectiveness. Medicare coverage began January 1, 2025 through new CMS Digital Mental Health Treatment (DMHT) G-codes. SleepioRx is distributed through employer wellness programs via PBM integration with partners like Evernorth and CVS Caremark.
one_liner: FDA-cleared CBT-I digital therapeutic for chronic insomnia with 76% improvement rate.

Employers seeking clinically validated digital sleep health
Sleep medicine physicians offering non-pharmacological options
Primary care practices treating chronic insomnia
not_for: Acute insomnia or sleep apnea treatment

nice_guidance.milestone: First-ever digital therapeutic to receive NICE guidance
nice_guidance.significance: Confirmed clinical and cost effectiveness for NHS (UK)

faqs.q: Is SleepioRx FDA approved for insomnia?
faqs.a: Yes, SleepioRx received FDA clearance on August 8, 2024 for treatment of chronic insomnia in adults 18+ as an adjunct to usual care.
Yes, Medicare coverage began January 1, 2025 through new CMS Digital Mental Health Treatment (DMHT) G-codes for both Medicare Fee-for-Service and Medicare Advantage.
Clinical studies show 76% of SleepioRx patients achieve improvement in insomnia. It was tested in 26 clinical trials including 18 randomized controlled trials.

faqs.q: Is SleepioRx available without a prescription?
faqs.a: No, SleepioRx is a prescription digital therapeutic requiring a clinician's prescription. Big Health also offers employer wellness versions through enterprise partnerships.
